title: Hati Nadhifu (Theme 4: Siku za wiki)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child claps the word, writes one syllable per clap in order, close together, and reads the word back.
representations: syllable cards to lay side by side
steps: Write each syllable close to the last.
contexts: siku za wiki: names of the days
labelling a picture of the family

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child joins ka + ka and ta + tu and reads them.

misconceptions.repair: Herufi za neno moja hukaa karibu: mama.

misconceptions.ask: Silabi ya kwanza unayoisikia ni ipi?
misconceptions.repair: Andika silabi kwa mpangilio unaozisikia: ta-tu.
Kila silabi huishia kwa irabu: ka-ka.

misconceptions.ask: Neno lako liko kwenye mstari mmoja?
misconceptions.repair: Silabi za neno moja hukaa kwenye mstari mmoja.
